newsitem.title: UK: Branson balloon down safely in Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Branson balloon down safely in Algeria.

text.p: Richard Branson's balloon landed safely in Algeria on Wednesday after technical problems forced the British businessman to abandon his round-the-world voyage, a spokesman for Branson said.
Project director Mike Kendrick told reporters that the balloon landed at 0729 GMT in the Algerian desert.
"The eagle has landed. No damage to capsule," Branson told his project team in London.
It was not immediately clear exactly where the balloon had landed.
Earlier, the Virgin Global Challenger control centre in London said the balloon would try to land in an area of Algeria about 50 to 70 miles (80 to 110 km) east of the border with Morocco.
Officials said the problems that caused the project to be abandoned seemed to stem from the ratio of ballast to helium in the balloon.
